en.description:
Poppy Pop is a cheerful flower-puzzle game built from scratch for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

Swipe and match three or more flowers of the same color to pop them. Every level is a little storybook scene with hand-painted crayon-and-watercolor art and a catchy original soundtrack.

• Story mode with 50 chapters, 10 worlds, bosses and a villain to beat.
• Endless mode: unlocks when you finish the story.
• Dialogues, videos and original music in every world.
• Your progress syncs through iCloud across iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
• Apple Watch face complication.
• Available in several languages, following your device language.

Free to play: World 1 (9 stages) and endless mode cost nothing. One in-app purchase, "Full game", unlocks every other world forever, no subscription. Anyone who paid for the earlier version keeps everything unlocked.

No account and no ads.

Requires iOS 16.0 or later (iPhone 6s or newer, iPad Air 2 or newer) and watchOS 11.0 or later for the watch app.
en.releaseNotes:
• Brand-new, more beautiful full-game screen.
• Fixes and improvements.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: New worlds: Coral Sea and Crystal Summit, with bosses, 13 new songs, better balance, louder sound and stability fixes.
Poppy Pop is now FREE: world 1 and endless mode at no cost. Unlock the full game (worlds 2 and 3) with a one-time purchase. Previous buyers keep everything.
Free to play! Improved search keywords and small fixes.
New: Hard Mode! Finish the story to unlock it - every stage fights like a boss. Plus smoother music loading when entering a stage.

What's new: Poppy Pop now runs on iPhone and iPad too, with the full 50-chapter story and Endless mode. Your progress syncs with Apple Watch through iCloud. Thank you to everyone who already bought the game: everything stays unlocked!

NEW: Versus & Worldwide online modes!
• Duel friends or nearby players, 2-4 player matches
• Worldwide Top 100 with country flags and boss-level challenges (play offline, scores upload later)
• Earth hub, attack rows (3+ cubes send weeds to rivals)
• Privacy options in Settings, including deleting your online data

Poppy Pop now has the same system on iPhone and Apple Watch: lives (they refill on their own), coins, continue after losing, and a shop. Everyone who bought the full game gets infinite lives forever plus 3000 free coins. Denser vines in story mode and new 3D boss videos.

NEW: Versus mode! Challenge up to 4 players in live duels, from Apple Watch to iPhone and iPad, with life bars and a Smash-style intro. Also: Versus selector for 2, 3 or 4 players on Apple Watch, a better-fitting board on Apple Watch Series 12, new boss story videos, and polish and fixes.

Versus mode is more fun than ever: up to 4 players with their Apple Watches. Player name tags now stay put during the intro, the intro uses a new random arena background each match, and the Apple Watch complication now shows the real Poppy Pop icon. Smoother difficulty curve: stages ramp up gently from stage 4 on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Bug fixes and performance improvements.

Poppy Pop 1.3.5
• Surprise gift: appears at random when you open the app.
• 2 lives per player (a new one every 45 min); lives can only be bought when you have none.
• Smarter prices: coin packs from US$0.49, more flowers per dollar as you buy more.
• A bit more challenge from stage 1.
• Fix: bosses now always start with a full life bar.
• Eclipse Emperor: a new twist final.

Poppy Pop 1.3.6
• World 1 is free. Unlock all 10 worlds, every boss and the twist ending with one purchase (includes the Florist Pack gift). No ads, no subscription. If you paid for the earlier version, everything stays unlocked.
• Epic ending video and new world videos.
• Stronger vibration.
• Online Versus: the three rounds continue smoothly.
• Bug fixes.

• Brand-new, more beautiful full-game screen.
• Fixes and improvements.
